---
name: sdem-explain
description: "Explain the last SDEM command output in plain words, with its source"
agent: agent
---

Explain the output of the last `sdem` command in the terminal, in plain words, for an architect new to SDEM.

- Say what the command did and what each part of the output means.
- For every fact, name its source: the command, and the record or link ids in the output.
- If something needs attention (an ERROR, a STOP, a chain that ends early), say what to do next and give the exact `sdem` command.
- Do not run commands unless I ask. Do not answer from memory.
